shared_elements: areas of repeated geometric hatching or grid-like pattern (net-like band in A, brick courses in B)
raised outlined shapes against a flat cut-back ground
justification: Both are shallow relief on stone organised into horizontal bands, with profile creatures set above and below a strip of dense repeated geometric hatching, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a tall, weathered pillar with a few large, schematic animal and abstract forms in isolation, while B is a wide, crowded narrative panel of human figures, wheeled machinery and architecture rendered with fine, controlled detail.
